applications_tracking_number_matches_sta.name: applications_tracking_number_matches_status
applications_tracking_number_matches_sta.value:
("applications"."status" = 'draft' and "applications"."tracking_number" is null)
          or ("applications"."status" <> 'draft' and "applications"."tracking_number" is not null)

document_pages_dimensions_positive.name: document_pages_dimensions_positive
document_pages_dimensions_positive.value: ("document_pages"."width" is null or "document_pages"."width" > 0) and ("document_pages"."height" is null or "document_pages"."height" > 0)

review_decisions_target_present.name: review_decisions_target_present
review_decisions_target_present.value: "review_decisions"."finding_id" is not null or "review_decisions"."extraction_id" is not null

review_decisions_finding_action_scope.name: review_decisions_finding_action_scope
review_decisions_finding_action_scope.value: "review_decisions"."finding_action" is null or "review_decisions"."finding_id" is not null

processing_jobs_idempotency_key_user_uni.name: processing_jobs_idempotency_key_user_unique
processing_jobs_idempotency_key_user_uni.where: "processing_jobs"."requested_by" is not null and "processing_jobs"."idempotency_key" is not null

processing_jobs_idempotency_key_system_u.name: processing_jobs_idempotency_key_system_unique
processing_jobs_idempotency_key_system_u.where: "processing_jobs"."requested_by" is null and "processing_jobs"."idempotency_key" is not null
